fact: 2010-04-07（抬头 Alba is 8 and 46）：8 岁的 Alba 又做了那个噩梦——她在黄房子楼上琴房里，天黑，乐谱撕破弄脏摊了一地，她读不懂却还是去捡，楼下有水；她害怕，醒来。
quote: Wednesday, April 7, 2010 (Alba is 8 and 46) … Alba: The bad dream again. I’m in the Yellow House, upstairs in the music room. It’s dark and the sheet music is all over the floor, torn and dirty. I can’t read it but I try to pick it up anyway. There’s water downstairs.

fact: 她以为天亮了，其实屋里只有台灯亮着：另一个 Alba 坐在她的椅子上，穿 Mama 的浴袍，手里一本书、一只装着「也许是酒」的果汁杯，头发很长、半灰（Mama 说的 salt-and-pepper）；那人过来坐到床上，像 Mama 那样搂住她。
quote: I think it’s morning because it’s light, but Other Alba is sitting in my chair with the reading lamp on, and I see it’s dark outside. She’s wearing Mama’s bathrobe … Her hair is really long and half gray, what Mama calls “salt-and-pepper.”

fact: 另一个 Alba 说现在是凌晨两点。小 Alba 问她从哪一年来：2047，再过两周就是圣诞，她离开时正有暴风雨要来；她刚给 Mama 买了一双鲜红的雨靴——小 Alba 嫌这礼物无聊，她说「有人就是想脚是干的」。
quote: “2047. It’ll be Christmas in a couple weeks. When I left there was a big storm coming.” … “Rain, probably. I just got Mama some bright red galoshes.” … “Some people like to keep their feet dry.”

fact: 另一个 Alba 问她见过 Beck 没有；说「Beck 会对你 Mama 好，也会对你好，我一直喜欢她，她聪明、不废话，而且好玩」；并预告：Mama 会花很多时间跟 Beck 在一起，小 Alba 可能会为此怨恨；Mama 以后几乎不哭了，小 Alba 可能会以为她不再想念 Daddy、忘了他。
quote: “Beck will be good for her. And for you, too. I’ve always liked her, she’s clever and no-nonsense. And fun.” … “Mama will spend a lot of time with Beck, and you might resent that.” … “She’ll hardly ever cry. You might think she doesn’t miss Daddy anymore, or she’s forgotten him.”

fact: 问到「Daddy 喜欢 Beck 吗」，答：「Daddy 不认识 Beck。就是说，他见过她一次，但他不知道她是谁。」小 Alba 追问「她是个秘密吗」，答「恐怕是，对不起」——Beck 是好秘密（你和 Mama 爱她），也是坏秘密（Daddy 知道会难过，会觉得被落下）。
quote: “Daddy doesn’t know Beck. That is, he met her once, but he didn’t know who she was.” … “I’m afraid so. Sorry.” … “Beck is a good secret because you and Mama love her. She’s a bad secret because Daddy might feel unhappy if he knew about Beck. He might feel . . . left out.”

fact: 另一个 Alba 读的书是外公（Grandpa）送小 Alba 的圣诞礼物——勋伯格《和声学》；她说「对八岁小孩不是好礼物，但你十五岁会爱上它」；小 Alba 担心外公会问她读了没有，答「我想 Mama 已经跟他把这事说清楚了」。
quote: She shows me the cover of her book. It’s the one Grandpa gave me for Christmas, Schoenberg’s Theory of Harmony. … “No, it’s brilliant, really. Not a great present for an eight-year-old kid, though. You’ll love it when you’re fifteen.”

fact: 两人挤在一张床上，另一个 Alba 握住她的手：那只手冷、瘦得硌人，不像 Mama 粗糙温暖的手，也完全不像自己的手——「感觉很有力，像 Daddy 的手」。她说在黑暗里说话更容易，「就像你在我脑子里说话，我在你脑子里」。
quote: She gets into bed next to me and holds my hand. Her hand is cold and kind of bony; it doesn’t feel like Mama’s rough warm hands, and it really doesn’t feel like my hand. It feels strong, like Daddy’s hands.

fact: 小 Alba 说梦里那座黄房子「不像安全的地方」，另一个 Alba 承认「是不安全，你待在屋里是对的」，并说屋外「只有风……除了黑暗和风，什么都没有」；她确认那个梦是真的，「那是很久以后」。
quote: “I know what you were dreaming about: music all over the floor, water in the Yellow House. I still have that dream sometimes.” … “It wasn’t safe. You were right to stay inside the house.” … “Just the wind,” she says. “Nothing but the dark and the wind.”

fact: 最后是一段耳语式的祝福：事情在变，你很快会见到 Beck，你会在未来看到不懂的东西，尽量别怕，什么都不会伤到你，「你会走过死荫的幽谷，不怕遭害」；你会掠过时间、必须保守秘密、有时会犯错；「你在这里是为了作见证」；人们会爱你、你也会爱他们，这有时让人糊涂；你会尽力，「你会没事的，我保证」。小 Alba 没听懂却答了 yes；她不记得自己睡着、也没做梦，醒来时另一个 Alba 已经不在了。
quote: “Close your eyes,” she whispers; her voice is inside my head. “Listen to me. Things are changing: you’ll meet Beck soon, and you’ll see things in the future that you won’t understand. Try not to be afraid. Nothing will hurt you. You’ll walk through the valley of the shadow of death, and fear no evil.” … “You are here to bear witness.” … “You’ll be fine, I promise.”
